sentences.text: CORAM : MANGESH S. PATIL, J.

DATE : 28.02.2020 P.C. :-
The applicant is seeking bail in anticipation of his arrest in connection with Crime No.381/2019 registered with Gondi Police Station, Dist.Jalna for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272,
273, 328 of the I.P.C. and under Sections 26(1), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 37(3)(e) of Section 59 of Food Safety Standards Act, 2006.
2] It is alleged that a Police Officer on suspicion accosted the applicant on 12/9/2019 and he was found in possession of 49 packets of Goa Gutkha worth Rs.9800/- which is an article prohibited by the Government Resolution dated 19/7/2019.
The muddemal was seized, samples were collected and the F.I.R. was registered.
3] The learned advocate for the applicant submits that except Section 328 of the I.P.C. other offences are bailable.
The stock has already been seized.
Since there are no allegations about he having administered Gutkha to (2) 908-aba171 anybody, Section 328 of the I.P.C. will not be applicable.
There are no criminal antecedents.
The applicant is ready to cooperate the Investigating Officer and he may be granted bail.
4] The learned A.P.P. opposes the application.

He submits that the preparation of Gutkha itself is Mainoddin S/O. Hasanji Tamboli vs The State Of Maharashtra on 28 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17210281/

sentences.text: Still the stock has been found in possession of the applicant.
He must be holding some more stock and there must be some racket.
To enable to procure it and to disclose it the application may be rejected.
5] I have carefully gone through the papers of investigation.
Except Section 328 of the I.P.C.
The offences being charged are bailable.
The stock has already been recovered.

Going by the ingredients constituting the offence punishable under Section 328 of the I.P.C. it is apparent that 'administration' of the substance is a necessary concomitant for constituting the crime.
It is not being alleged that the applicant has administered the Gutkha to anybody.
6] There are no criminal antecedents.

Though it is being alleged that inspite of service of notice under Section 41(A) of Cr.P.C. the applicant has not cooperated the Investigating Officer, it is apparent that he is before this Court for grant of bail in anticipation of his arrest and could not have been expected to have obliged the Investigating Officer pursuant to the notice under Section 41(A) of the Cr.P.C.
7] The application is allowed.

(3) 908-aba171 8] In the event of arrest of applicant in connection with Crime No.381/2019 registered with Gondi Police Station, Dist.Jalna for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the I.P.C. and under Sections 26(1), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 37(3)(e) of Section 59 of Food Safety Standards Act, 2006, he shall be released on bail on his executing personal recognizance for an amount of Rs.15,000/- (Rs.Fifteen thousand only) and furnishing a solvent surety in the like amount subject to following conditions :
a] He shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when called by the Investigating Officer and shall cooperate him.
b] He shall not tamper the evidence or influence the witnesses.
c] He shall not repeat the offence.
